model: Full supplied four-solid half model, conforming P1 tetrahedra and perfect welded contact. No geometric reduction. Adiabatic symmetry and ends. Internal Dirichlet from supplied ramp; external h=1e-6 to 50 C. Steady state at t=0.
material: Solid 2 carbon, solids 1/3/4 SA312. Steffen monotone cubic interpolation of supplied k and kappa, k multiplied by 0.001, volumetric heat capacity k/kappa. Material evaluated at tetrahedron centroid temperature.
time_integration: Nonlinear implicit midpoint with consistent mass; Picard iteration to maximum nodal update <2e-6 C. Steps split at ramp breakpoints and 99.936s.

field_schema.node_ids: Gmsh tags, array row order for nodal fields
field_schema.times_s: all time steps, includes initial steady state
field_schema.probe_temperature_C: (times,4): SCL2 inner,outer,SCL4 inner,outer; tetrahedral barycentric interpolation
field_schema.external_triangles: zero-based nodal indices for Robin facets
field_schema.symmetry_triangles: zero-based nodal indices for adiabatic symmetry facets
field_schema.end_triangles: zero-based nodal indices for the two adiabatic end surfaces

extraction: Maximum/minimum of inner minus outer over all computed time steps; outer temperatures at explicitly included 99.936 s; no averaging across SCLs.
mesh_protocol: Gmsh MeshAdapt surfaces, Delaunay tetrahedra, linear geometry. Original BREP face tags preserved. Mesh size background min(global_size, local_size+0.12*sqrt(x^2+y^2+(z-53)^2)), with boundary extension enabled. Fine mesh is shared between the final two time-step studies.
limitations: P1 straight-sided tetrahedra approximate curved CAD; constitutive coefficients use centroid quadrature. Spatial and temporal sensitivity is quantified in refinement.json. Time extrema are maxima/minima of discrete time histories, including exact ramp knots.
